label: Rigidity of concrete GOD_4 presence gives persistence (inference)
meaning: Same signature, profile and standpoint. If x is a concrete GOD_4 at w and some concrete GOD_4 y exists at an accessible v, rigidity gives y = x, so x exists at v. The backing result of the strength order rigidity strengthens persistence; the fixedPlusVisitor control shows the converse fails. Declared an instantiation of the vocabulary lemma.
